950-4613-6218.easyPrerequisites:
Pheres-Band Tromper doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Fatestitcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
950-4613-6218.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
950-4613-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3499-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-8175.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

654-4477-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-4477-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-4477-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Greenwarden of Murasa and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7606-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2645-7908.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Halflings.
2645-7908.description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

676-969-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-969-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2928-3558-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2928-3558-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

338-475-549-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-475-549-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1008-1619-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1008-1619-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Undermountain Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

4929-6805-7743.description:
Activate Royal Herbalist, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {2}.
Repeat.

4067-6609-7719.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6609-7719.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

240-643-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-3967.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

2511-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1993-3259-3478--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.

Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-4885-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3169-5639-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
2034-3169-5639-7070.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3375-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

5465-5639-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
5465-5639-7070.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Arm-Mounted Anchor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3534-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3534-6620.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
250-779-1479-3534-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-2034-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
222-527-2034-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2741-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3062-6575-6774--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Loading Zone and Pir, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2510-2781-6867.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4636-5391-6291.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot and Thopter enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

957-1987-2239-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-2239-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

1409-2933-5223-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-5223-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

849-1020-1117-4985-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {R}.
When Junk Diver dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {2}.
Repeat.

678-3621-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Repeat.

224-391-2653-4967.notablePrerequisites: Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
224-391-2653-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

2557-3317-3389-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
2557-3317-3389-4050.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Flickering Ward enters the battlefield, triggering Historian's Boon's first ability, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature with Flickering Ward attached and a Soldier token, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2113-3995-4684.notablePrerequisites:
Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
Karametra's Favor attached to Horseshoe Crab.
2113-3995-4684.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping Horseshoe Crab.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.

215-721-2724.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

608-969-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
608-969-3259.description:
Deal combat damage with Xyris and the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Xyris and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Xyris trigger, causing you and the opponent dealt combat damage to draw cards equal to the damage dealt by Xyris.
Xyris triggers for each card the opponent draws, creating that many 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, sacrificing the enchanted creature, attaching Breath of Fury to a Snake token, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
